target_columns.name: renewal_candidate_count
target_columns.transformation: count of rows per product_line after filtering to Active policies with end_date within [AsOfDate, AsOfDate+60 days]

target_columns.name: total_sum_insured_up_for_renewal
target_columns.transformation: sum of sum_insured per product_line for the same filtered rows, rounded to 2 decimal places

quirks: @AsOfDate is a hardcoded literal ('2024-09-01'), not derived from current date -- any reimplementation must parameterize this explicitly rather than defaulting to today's date, or results will silently diverge

BETWEEN on end_date is inclusive on both bounds, so policies expiring exactly on AsOfDate or exactly 60 days later are both included -- an off-by-one in a non-inclusive date-range implementation would under-count
DATEADD(DAY, 60, @AsOfDate) is recomputed per-row implicitly as a constant; ensure the 60-day window is calendar days, not business days
status filter is a literal string match on 'Active' -- case sensitivity and any other status values (e.g. 'active', 'ACTIVE', 'Lapsed') must be handled consistently with legacy collation rules

no NULL-handling on end_date or status: rows with NULL end_date or NULL status are implicitly excluded by the WHERE clause (NULL BETWEEN and NULL = comparisons evaluate to unknown/false) -- must preserve this implicit exclusion rather than erroring or including them

no explicit handling of policies with product_line NULL -- these would form their own GROUP BY bucket (NULL group) in T-SQL; PySpark's groupBy also groups nulls together, but this should be verified/documented rather than assumed

ROUND uses standard rounding (round-half-away-from-zero in T-SQL) -- Spark's round() may use round-half-up/banker's rounding depending on implementation, so verify rounding mode parity for the reconciliation report

this is a reference re-implementation, not the original SAS/SQL engine behavior -- per repo convention, the reconciliation report must state this plainly and not claim verified parity with a production legacy system
